title: Routing + Auth field notes — standup 2026-11-24
content:
Attendees: Evelyn, Mateo, Jin, Sana, small satellite: Priya (SRE), Omar (serving runtime)

Purpose: quick sync to capture field observations from the last 72h canary in eu-west-1, align on next steps for token rotation rollout, and triage a quota enforcement corner-case surfaced by CS on Wed.

Agenda:
- Canary results (eu-west-1) for new routing allocator policy
- Auth token rotation plan: phased vs big-bang
- Quota enforcement bug summary + mitigation
- Action items / owners / timelines

Notes / Observations:
1) Canary — routing allocator (policy v2):
- Deployed 11/20 to 10% of traffic (control plane + routing layer change: prefer low-latency region fallback instead of cost-first when region score delta < 5%).
- Observed 6% improvement in p95 request latency for short-chat workloads (<=128 tokens) routed to us-west-2 after warmup (~3 hours).
- Cost delta: marginally higher (0.8% token-cost uplift) due to shifted traffic to slightly more expensive pools during peak.
- Two small regressions: a) one outlier where KV cache miss storm led to 180s tail latency on 11/21 03:14 UTC (root cause: stale cache metadata in allocator shard shard-7), b) slight increase in cold-starts on Dedicated GPU nodes where instance scaling lagged autoscaler by ~30s.
- Decision: keep policy v2 but add guardrails for cache-metadata revalidation and tighten autoscaler probe interval for Dedicated from 15s -> 10s.

2) Auth token rotation (customer-facing keys + internal service tokens):
- Background: monthly KMS rotation scheduled; discovered that legacy clients (internal: batch-embedder v0.9) use long-lived cached credentials causing 401 spikes during rotation window.
- Two approaches discussed:
  a) Phased rotation: rotate service tokens per-cluster with backoff-aware retry shim (~2 week rollout),
  b) Immediate global rotation with 24-hour fallback acceptance window (shorter but riskier).
- Risk assessment: CS reported ~4 customers on Dedicated may have automation that breaks on immediate rotation. Enterprise team prefers phased.
- Action: implement shim (retry + token-refresh hook) in internal SDKs (Mateo) + schedule phased rotation starting 2026-12-02 for non-critical clusters; global rotation as fallback (Sana to draft rollback playbook).

3) Quotas — enforcement corner-case and mitigation:
- Customer report: "rate-limit exceeded" errors during bursty embed requests from iOS app; errors didn't surface in quota dashboards correctly (under-reporting).
- Root cause: quota enforcement path uses aggregated per-tenant counters with eventual consistency; bursts from ephemeral mobile clients caused race where enforcement window wasn't updated before allocator decision, leading to temporary over-allow followed by abrupt throttling.
- Short-term mitigation: enable per-instance in-memory fast-check for high-rps tenants (Jin to flip feature flag for 5 tenants on Thursday), add temporary smoothing window (250ms) at edge.
- Long-term: move to a hybrid quota store backed by Redis hot-path + eventual Cassandra aggregate; spike scheduled (2d) to prototype Redis hot-path (PLT-2398).

4) Incidents & post-mortem snippets:
- KV cache metadata stale incident (11/21): root cause noted above; post-mortem draft started (Evelyn). Next steps: add explicit revalidation on allocator leader election, and add metric rule for cache-store-lag > 5s -> pager.

5) Metrics snapshot (11/24 morning):
- p50 short-chat latency: 42ms (baseline 45ms)
- p95 short-chat latency: 180ms (baseline 192ms)
- error-rate (all): 0.27% (target <0.5%)
- quota-throttles (platform-wide/day): 1.2k (spike from mobile embed bursts)

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we accept the 0.8% cost uplift in exchange for p95 latency gains, or can runtime opt for dynamic cost-capping per-tenant? (suggested owner: Product — bring to roadmap review)
- How aggressive should phased token rotation be for Dedicated customers on compliance contracts? (Legal / Enterprise input required)

Decisions made:
- Keep allocator policy v2 in canary with the cache revalidation guardrail and tighter autoscaler probe.
- Implement phased token rotation; SDK shim to be landed before 2026-12-02.
- Short-term quota smoothing (250ms) + in-memory fast-check for high-rps tenants as immediate mitigation.

Action items (owner — ETA):
- Mateo: implement SDK retry + token-refresh shim, PR by 2026-11-30, test matrix for legacy batch clients.
- Jin: flip in-memory quota fast-check flag for 5 pilot tenants, monitor; target 2026-11-26.
- Sana: draft token-rotation rollback playbook and customer comms template; 2026-11-27.
- Evelyn: finish post-mortem draft for KV cache metadata incident; 2026-11-28.
- Omar: tighten autoscaler probe interval on Dedicated to 10s and run smoke tests; 2026-11-25.
- Platform-ops: spin up 2-node Redis prototype for quota hot-path spike (PLT-2398), schedule spike week of 2026-12-08.

Quick notes to follow up in next standup:
- Verify if cache revalidation prevents the 180s tail after re-deploy (Evelyn).
- SDK shim telemetry: how many clients refresh tokens proactively vs after 401s (Mateo).
- Early telemetry from the in-memory quota flag for pilot tenants (Jin).

Misc / scratchpad:
- Link to allocator logs: s3://redwood-logs/allocator/eu-west-1/2026-11-21-03 (Evelyn) — extract p95 per-shard and attach to PM draft.
- Draft subject line for customer comms: "Planned token rotation — what to expect and how to verify your integration" (Sana).

End of notes.
